description: Otaq agent signals from GitHub Copilot: each hook passes its JSON to `otaq hook --tool copilot <event>`, which does nothing unless OTAQ_TICKET is set (and nothing at all when otaq isn't installed). Copilot maps the Claude event names; errorOccurred is its own.

hooks.command: command -v otaq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; otaq hook --tool copilot Notification
command -v otaq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; otaq hook --tool copilot SessionStart
command -v otaq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; otaq hook --tool copilot Stop
command -v otaq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; otaq hook --tool copilot UserPromptSubmit
command -v otaq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; otaq hook --tool copilot errorOccurred
